editorial.blurb: Boka is a Michelin-starred Chicago institution where Chef Lee Wolen's refined yet approachable cooking feels effortless, delivered in a polished yet laid-back atmosphere that welcomes everyone from families to anniversary diners.
editorial.insiderTip: Book through OpenTable for last-minute openings, sit at the bar for attentive service, and consider à la carte over the tasting menu to pace your own experience—the staff will happily split portions for sharing.

topDishes.note: Perfectly cooked with incredible flavor, the absolute standout across multiple visits
Beautifully executed, though cucumber accompaniment can overpower delicate sweetness
Rich yet balanced brownie-style dessert with butterscotch sauce and complimentary truffles
